proof_body:
by
  intro n k
  have hc : n.choose k = (Finset.powersetCard k (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [hc, ← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  have himg : ((Finset.powersetCard k (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) : Finset (Finset (Fin n))) : Set (Finset (Fin n))) = (fun a : Fin k → Fin n => Finset.univ.image a) '' {a : Fin k → Fin n | StrictMono a} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, hS⟩
      exact ⟨S.orderEmbOfFin hS, (S.orderEmbOfFin hS).strictMono, Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ S hS⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ ha.injective]
      simp
  rw [himg]
  symm
  refine Set.InjOn.ncard_image ?_
  intro a ha b hb hab
  refine (StrictMono.range_inj ha hb).mp ?_
  have := congrArg (fun s : Finset (Fin n) => (s : Set (Fin n))) hab
  simpa using this
target_source: ∀ n k : ℕ, Set.ncard {a : Fin k → Fin n | StrictMono a} = n.choose k
